import_charging_sites.title: Import charging-location database
import_charging_sites.description:
Select a Ford Triplog charging-site database in JSON format. The existing database will be backed up automatically and replaced after successful validation.

The latest charging-site databases for all supported countries are available in the [GitHub "charging_sites" folder](${github_url}).

data_description.charging_site_file: For example charging_sites_de.json, charging_sites_at.json or charging_sites_ch.json.

import_charging_sites_success.title: Import successful

download_charging_sites.title: Download charging-location database
download_charging_sites.description:
Select the country whose charging locations should be downloaded directly from OpenStreetMap. The existing database is backed up automatically before activation.

**Note:** After downloading, the charging locations are processed and optimized locally. Depending on the database size and hardware, this may take several minutes. The progress bar may temporarily remain unchanged.

data_description.charging_site_country: Select a country or “← Back” to return to the OpenStreetMap menu.

download_charging_sites_success.title: Charging-location database activated successfully
download_charging_sites_success.description:
The charging-location database for **{country} ({country_code})** was downloaded from OpenStreetMap, processed and activated successfully.

**Download and processing**
- OSM elements: **{downloaded_elements}**
- Normalized charging stations: **{normalized_stations}**
- Detected charging locations: **{searchable_sites}**
- Geohash cells: **{index_cells}**
- Skipped elements: **{skipped_elements}**

**Database**
- Size: **{database_size}**
- Total duration: **{duration}**

The new database is immediately available for charging-location detection.

download_charging_sites_progress.title: Charging-location database is being created

download_charging_sites_result.title: Charging-location database completed
download_charging_sites_result.description: The charging-location database was created and activated successfully.

route_tracker_settings.title: Route Tracker
route_tracker_settings.description: Enable separate route recording and select the position source. This setting does not replace the existing Ford Triplog vehicle tracker.

data_description.route_tracker_enabled: Records GPS points during a trip using a separate position source.
data_description.route_source_type: Select the integration from which the Route Tracker receives its GPS coordinates.

route_tracker_source.title: Route Tracker position source
route_tracker_source.description: Configure the entities for the selected position source: {source_type}.

data_description.route_latitude_entity: Sensor that provides the current latitude.
data_description.route_longitude_entity: Sensor that provides the current longitude.
data_description.route_geocoded_entity: Home Assistant Companion App Geocoded Location sensor with the “location” attribute.

data_description.smart_trip: Short intermediate stops are automatically merged into one trip.
data_description.charging: Charging status sensor (available only for FordPass electric vehicles).
data_description.charging_site_country: Country of the currently used OpenStreetMap charging-location database.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: The usable battery capacity of the vehicle. Default: 77 kWh.
data_description.journey_home_zone: Zone whose arrival can end a journey.
data_description.journey_home_timeout_minutes: The journey ends only after the vehicle has remained in the journey base for at least this amount of time. 0 minutes ends the journey immediately.
data_description.journey_max_gap_hours: Maximum time between two trips before a new journey starts. This value is used as a fallback when no journey base can be used.
data_description.home_tariff_enabled: Automatically calculates costs for charging sessions at the journey base.
data_description.home_tariff_summer_price: Price per kWh for charging sessions from 1 April to 30 September.
data_description.home_tariff_winter_price: Price per kWh for charging sessions from 1 October to 31 March.
data_description.home_tariff_currency: Currency used for automatically calculated home charging costs.

osrm_settings.title: OSRM Route Smoothing
osrm_settings.description:
Ford Triplog can optionally match recorded GPS routes to the OpenStreetMap road network using an external local OSRM service. Without an enabled OSRM connection, the existing raw route remains fully available.

When saving, the connection is tested. A matching radius of 15 metres is used by default.

data_description.osrm_enabled: Enables optional local route smoothing using OSRM.
data_description.osrm_match_radius: Search radius per GPS point. Recommended and default: 15 m.

osrm_connection_result.title: OSRM connection saved
